faqs.p: What is LifeWave X₂O?
faqs.r: LifeWave X₂O is the first and only hydration system that infuses water with light—making light available to the body in a completely new way.

faqs.p: How does LifeWave X₂O work?
faqs.r: The system uses patented light-infusion technology and advanced dual-stage filtration with hydrogen enrichment to deliver clean, energized water that supports the body at the cellular level.

faqs.p: What does LifeWave X₂O do?
faqs.r: LifeWave X₂O is the world’s first water system that delivers light into the body through the water you drink. It transforms ordinary water into a powerful wellness medium—infused with light energy to optimize hydration at the cellular level—energizing, restoring, and renewing from within.

faqs.p: What makes LifeWave X₂O different from other water filters?
faqs.r: LifeWave X₂O is the first system to deliver light into the body through the water you drink. It goes beyond filtration to energize and optimize hydration from within, with some reporting effects occurring within seconds of consumption.

faqs.p: How do I use the LifeWave X₂O?
faqs.r: Simply fill the reservoir with your preferred water source (tap, spring, distilled, or deuterium-depleted), power on the unit, and select the treatment cycle. The system will automatically filter, energize, and enrich the water. After approximately 45 minutes, the treated water is ready to drink. For step-by-step guidance, refer to the Quick Start Guide or User Manual included in your package.

faqs.p: How do I update the firmware on my LifeWave X2O?
faqs.r: Please refer to the linked document and video for step-by-step instructions on how to update your LifeWave X2O firmware.

faqs.p: How quickly can I feel the effects of the water?
faqs.r: You may see or feel results in seconds. The patented light processing technology infuses light into the water you drink for incredible health benefits; some people feel results in less than a minute of drinking.

faqs.p: How long can the benefits of drinking the LifeWave X₂O water last?
faqs.r: The immediate effects, such as improved hydration or energy, may be felt within minutes and can last for several hours. LifeWave X₂O is most effective for long-term wellness benefits when used consistently as part of your daily hydration routine. While many users report positive effects, more scientific studies are needed to fully understand the long-term benefits of light-infused water.

faqs.p: How long does the light infusion remain effective after dispensing?
faqs.r: The water is in a "charged state" following the light infusion process and is best consumed immediately after dispensing.

faqs.p: Does the water’s appearance change over time?
faqs.r: The water’s appearance should remain consistent over time.

faqs.p: What is the best time of the day to drink the water?
faqs.r: LifeWave X₂O water is best taken daily, in the morning upon waking, preferably on an empty stomach. We also advise that you drink it at room temperature, with no ice, for maximum benefits.

faqs.p: What container should I put the water in?
faqs.r: ONLY place our water into a glass container and do NOT use a plastic container.

faqs.p: How many glasses can I have per day?
faqs.r: You only need one 450 ml/15 oz glass of LifeWave X₂O water per day. Note that LifeWave X₂O water should not replace your daily water intake but supplement it.

faqs.p: Can I cook with the water or use it for coffee?
faqs.r: We DO NOT recommend that people boil the water as it might lose its efficacy.

faqs.p: How many times a day can the machine be run?
faqs.r: There is no set limit to the number of times the machine can be run. Note that increased use will mean that filters need to be replaced more frequently.

faqs.p: Can I give LifeWave X₂O light-infused water to my pets?
faqs.r: We have not conducted any trials on animals. LifeWave X₂O water consumption is recommended for humans only.

faqs.p: What Type of Water Can I Use in The System?
faqs.r: You may use tap, spring, filtered, distilled, or deuterium-depleted water. Do not use alkaline, carbonated water, or add minerals.

faqs.p: What is the temperature of the water dispensed from the LifeWave X₂O system?
faqs.r: The water will be dispensed at room temperature (68-77°F/20-25°C)

faqs.p: What size is the water reservoir?
faqs.r: LifeWave X₂O can hold up to 2 liters of water in its reservoir.

faqs.p: How long does it take to produce a glass of water?
faqs.r: The machine can produce two 450 ml/15 oz glasses of water approximately every 45 minutes.

faqs.p: How long after dispensing two 450 ml/15 oz glasses of treated water can I process additional glasses?
faqs.r: If two glasses are dispensed, the machine will require an additional 45 minutes to process the next batch of water. The touch-screen display will notify you when the next two glasses are ready.

faqs.p: How many filtration steps are there?
faqs.r:
Our machine uses a two-step filtration process before entering our light-infusion stage. The primary water filtration stage is designed to reduce a broad range of impurities found in municipal tap water.*

The secondary filtration stage further improves purity while adding hydrogen to the water.

* Our Primary Filter technology is currently undergoing accredited laboratory testing, state registrations, and full NSF certification. The Primary Filter was previously tested to remove all major water contaminants. In order for us to make formal written claims, the filter requires additional testing in our product configuration. We have selected this premium filter to best integrate with our technology, as well as with the secondary filtration and Hydrogen stages. This filter forms the core of LifeWave X2O’s contaminant-reduction system. Created from a powerful filter system that is designed to reduce a broad range of impurities found in municipal tap water.

faqs.p: What is the filtration capacity of the filters?
faqs.r:
Each 450 ml/15 oz glass of water adds up quickly — but our high-capacity filters are designed to last up to 6 months under typical daily use. After 6 months, we recommend replacing both filters to maintain optimal performance.

• The Primary Filter processes up to 250 gallons — equivalent to around 10 glasses per day.

• The Secondary Filter handles 150 gallons, or approximately 6 glasses per day.

For higher-use households, the LifeWave X₂O system is equipped with a smart display that will notify you when it’s time to replace a filter, ensuring uninterrupted access to light-infused water.

faqs.p: What happens if a light-processing panel malfunctions?
faqs.r: When a light panel inside the machine malfunctions, a message will appear on the screen with a code instructing the customer to contact our customer service department.

faqs.p: Does the machine have a shelf life?
faqs.r: LifeWave X₂O doesn’t have a set expiry date or shelf life. However, it is recommended that the filters be replaced annually. The touch-screen display will alert you when it is time to replace the filters. Follow the machine’s maintenance guidelines for optimal performance.

faqs.p: Can I Move or Transport My LifeWave X₂O™ After Filling It with Water?
faqs.r: We do not recommend moving the unit once water has been added, as this can temporarily affect performance and may cause damage.

faqs.p: What If I Need to Relocate My LifeWave X₂O™?
faqs.r:
If you must move it, please follow these steps:

• Keep the unit in your possession — do not ship it via courier or postal services.

• Always keep it upright during transport to prevent water from shifting inside.

• Fully drain the unit before moving. You can find instructions in the “Draining the System” section of your manual.

Returning to LifeWave: Shipping is only allowed when prepared according to the “How to Prepare Your LifeWave X₂O Unit for Shipment” guide , available through customer services. Not following these instructions may affect performance and will void your warranty.

faqs.p: How do I clean my machine?
faqs.r: For detailed instructions on cleaning your machine, please refer to the LifeWave X₂O User Manual .

faqs.p: What products should be avoided when cleaning my machine?
faqs.r: Avoid harsh chemicals like bleach and abrasive sponges like steel wools and scouring pads. If unsure about a cleaning product, test it on a small, discreet area first. Use cotton or paper towels for water absorption (local cleaning).

faqs.p: Is there a risk of sediment buildup in the machine if someone has hard water?
faqs.r: Yes, it is possible that sediment can build up in the machine. We recommend cleaning every 3-6 months, depending on your water quality.

faqs.p: Should the water in the reservoir be replaced after a specific period?
faqs.r: Yes, we recommend replacing the water every 2-3 days to ensure freshness. Some users may prefer changing it daily, which is also fine.

faqs.p: Is there a filter fouling/anti-bacterial solution if water is left in the reservoir?
faqs.r: We do not recommend leaving water sitting in the reservoir for any lengthy duration, and it should be changed every 2-3 days.

faqs.p: How do I change the filters?
faqs.r: For detailed instructions on replacing your primary or secondary filter, please refer to the LifeWave X₂O User Manual .

faqs.p: Where can I service my machine?
faqs.r: As of now, LifeWave will not be offering any servicing.

faqs.p: What Should I Do If My LifeWave X2O System Stops Working or Displays An Error?
faqs.r: Check the display panel for error messages and consult the user manual. If the issue persists, contact LifeWave Customer Service for assistance.

faqs.p: What If the Light Panel or Touchscreen Stops Responding?
faqs.r: Try restarting the unit. If the problem continues, discontinue use and contact Customer Service for support.

faqs.p: Will LifeWave be offering financing for the machine?
faqs.r: Yes, financing is available for the LifeWave X₂O Light-Infused Water system through PayPal’s Buy Now, Pay Later options at checkout. However, filter replacements are not eligible for financing and must be purchased outright. For more information, view the LifeWave X₂O financing information .

faqs.p: Will this product be available outside of the U.S.?
faqs.r: LifeWave X₂O will launch in the U.S. in April 2026. Select international markets will be announced throughout 2026.

faqs.p: Are there any state-specific purchase restrictions for LifeWave X₂O?
faqs.r: Yes. Temporary purchase restrictions currently apply in California, Wisconsin, and Iowa. These restrictions are scheduled to be lifted in 2026.
